name: musicfit
description: musicfit: fit a music track to a video cut, exactly the length you need, cut on bar lines, with the drop on the second you pick.

plugins.name: musicfit
plugins.description: Makes a music track exactly as long as a video by cutting or looping whole bars, lands its drop on a chosen second, ends it on a beat, ducks it under a voice, sets its loudness and can lay it under the video, with cues.json (every beat and bar in seconds and frames) for the edit.
